milestones.label: Applications open for 2027 entry (international graduate students)
milestones.source_text: Peking University's international students office says the 2027-entry application period for international master's and doctoral applicants starts on 26 October 2026. Two scholarship websites (After School Africa, DAAD Scholarship) report the same window.

milestones.label: Application deadline for 2027 entry (international graduate students)
milestones.source_text: Peking University's international students office gives 25 December 2026 as the closing date of the general application. No separate scholarship deadline is given on the page; scholarship consideration follows the same application.

milestones.label: Second examination round run by the schools and departments
milestones.source_text: The university says each school or department holds a second-round assessment between January and March 2027 and publishes its own dates.

milestones.label: Preliminary admission lists published
milestones.source_text: Schools and departments post their preliminary admission lists before the end of May 2027, according to the university.

milestones.label: Original documents due from pre-admitted candidates
milestones.source_text: Candidates who are pre-admitted must send their original documents by 31 May 2027 (university notice).

milestones.label: Admission notices issued
milestones.source_text: The university says admission notices are issued in late June 2027, with enrolment in early September 2027.
